Types of medical and monitoring devices available:

Pulse oximeters
(saturómetros) to measure blood oxygen levels.
Traditional home diagnostic tools
like digital thermometers and blood glucose test strips.

At
Farmacias Ahumada
, you can buy
FDA-approved continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) like the
FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus
and the
Accu-Chek Smart Guide Sensor
. The pharmacy does not sell smartwatches or non-invasive blood glucose watches.
Farmacias Ahumada
Continuous Glucose Monitors at Farmacias Ahumada
FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus:
A 15-day sensor that tracks glucose every minute and sends data via Bluetooth to your phone.
Accu-Chek Smart Guide Sensor:
A continuous monitor that tracks interstitial fluid trends and alerts.
Farmacias Ahumada
Smartwatches and Wearables Context
Smartwatches & Blood Sugar:
Major health authorities and regulatory groups warn that wrist-based smartwatches or smart rings claiming to measure blood glucose non-invasively are
not
clinically validated or approved.
U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov)
ECG & Sleep Trackers:
Standard smartwatches (like Apple Watch or Samsung Galaxy Watch) offer certified ECG and sleep tracking features, but they link to CGM apps rather than performing direct blood sugar readings.
